# Game Idea: Meteor Dodge

- **Genre:** Arcade action
- **Core mechanic:** Player controls a ship with arrow keys, moving freely within the canvas. Meteors spawn from the top and fall at random speeds and angles.
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible, earning points over time.
- **Lose condition:** The game ends immediately when the ship collides with any meteor.

<content>
1: // Simple Meteor Dodge game targeting canvas with id="game"
2: (() => {
3:   // Create starfield background
4:   const STAR_COUNT = 80;
5:   const stars = [];
6:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
7:     stars.push({
8:       x: Math.random() * width,
9:       y: Math.random() * height,
10:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
11:     });
12:   }
13:   function drawStars() {
14:     ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
15:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
16:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
17:     for (const s of stars) {
18:       ctx.beginPath();
19:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
20:       ctx.fill();
21:     }
22:   }
23:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
24:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
25:   // Audio setup
26:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
27:   function beep(freq, duration) {
28:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
29:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
30:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
31:     osc.connect(gain);
32:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
33:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
34:     osc.start();
35:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
36:   }
37:   const width = canvas.width;
38:   const height = canvas.height;
39: 
40:   // Ship configuration
41:   const ship = {
42:     x: width / 2,
43:     y: height - 30,
44:     radius: 15,
45:     speed: 4,
46:     dx: 0,
47:     dy: 0,
48:   };
49: 
50:   // Input handling
51:   const keys = {};
52:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
53:     // Resume audio context on first interaction
54:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
55:     keys[e.key] = true;
56:   });
57:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => (keys[e.key] = false));
58: 
59:   // Meteor class
60:   class Meteor {
61:     constructor() {
62:       this.reset();
63:     }
64: reset() {
65:     this.x = Math.random() * width;
66:     this.y = -20; // start above canvas
67:     const angle = (Math.random() * Math.PI) / 3 - Math.PI / 6; // -30° to +30°
68:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3; // 2-5 px/frame
69:     this.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
70:     this.vy = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
71:     this.radius = 10 + Math.random() * 10; // 10-20
72:     beep(200, 0.08); // spawn sound
73:   }
74:     update() {
75:       this.x += this.vx;
76:       this.y += this.vy;
77:       if (this.y - this.radius > height || this.x < -this.radius || this.x > width + this.radius) {
78:         this.reset();
79:       }
80:     }
81:     draw() {
82:       ctx.beginPath();
83:       ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
84:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
85:       ctx.fill();
86:     }
87:   }
88: 
89:   const meteors = [];
90:   const METEOR_COUNT = 5;
91:   for (let i = 0; i < METEOR_COUNT; i++) meteors.push(new Meteor());
92: 
93:   let startTime = performance.now();
94:   let gameOver = false;
95: 
96: function updateShip() {
97:     ship.dx = 0;
98:     ship.dy = 0;
99:     let moved = false;
100:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) { ship.dx = -ship.speed; moved = true; }
101:     if (keys.ArrowRight) { ship.dx = ship.speed; moved = true; }
102:     if (keys.ArrowUp) { ship.dy = -ship.speed; moved = true; }
103:     if (keys.ArrowDown) { ship.dy = ship.speed; moved = true; }
104:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(width - ship.radius, ship.x + ship.dx));
105:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(height - ship.radius, ship.y + ship.dy));
106:     if (moved) beep(400, 0.05);
107:   }
108: 
109:   function drawShip() {
110:     ctx.beginPath();
111:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
112:     ctx.arc(ship.x, ship.y, ship.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
113:     ctx.fill();
114:   }
115: 
116:   function checkCollision() {
117:     for (const m of meteors) {
118:       const dx = m.x - ship.x;
119:       const dy = m.y - ship.y;
120:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
121:       if (dist < m.radius + ship.radius) {
122:         gameOver = true;
123:         beep(150, 0.3); // collision sound
124:         break;
125:       }
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function drawScore() {
130:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
132:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
133:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
134:   }
135: 
136:   function loop() {
137:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
138:     drawStars();
139:     if (!gameOver) {
140:       updateShip();
141:       meteors.forEach((m) => m.update());
142:       checkCollision();
143:     }
144:     drawShip();
145:     meteors.forEach((m) => m.draw());
146:     drawScore();
147:     if (gameOver) {
148:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
149:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
150:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 80, height / 2);
151:     } else {
152:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
153:     }
154:   }
155: 
156:   // Start the game loop
157:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
158: })();

(End of file - total 158 lines)
</content>
